entities.name: C5BW79 DNA ligase
observations: The supplied 512-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt C5BW79 from Beutenbergia cavernae; annotated as probable DNA ligase, EC 6.5.1.1.
DNA ligase seals nicks in double-stranded DNA during replication, recombination, and repair; annotation specifies Mg2+ as cofactor.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: The C5BW79 DNA ligase reference annotation lists Mg2+ (CHEBI:CHEBI:18420) as a cofactor.
